concept: NPC-driven tasks with narrative and combat objectives.
progression: Currently 20 quests live; new quests are added regularly.
examples: Viktors Zweifel – deliver a message to Linda
Zombie-Jagd mit Stil – eliminate 50 infected with a kitchen knife within 2 hours
Die Suche nach Frank – find Frank in an abandoned fire station and hand him a data stick
how_to_start: Speak to Viktor in the starter area to receive your first quest.
rewards: Money, items, and reputation based on quest difficulty.
